title: trema morifolium
intro: Trema morifolium, commonly known as White Muskroot, is a plant species belonging to the family Cannabaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and protect against infections. The bioactive constituents of Trema morifolium contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and skin infections.
